PROJECT: Multi-site static template (first site: Desh Bhakt). Angular 20, prerendered (`outputMode: 'static'`),
deployed to Azure Static Web Apps. No database. Content is JSON in content/<locale>/. Locales: en, hi, mr.
Full architecture: Prompt.md. Setup and new-site checklist: README.md.

ANGULAR
- Standalone components only, no NgModules. Signals for state. OnPush change detection everywhere.
- New control flow only: @if / @for / @switch / @defer. Never *ngIf / *ngFor.
- Strict TypeScript. No `any`. Content shapes come from src/app/core/content/content.types.ts.
- inject() over constructor injection.

STATIC / PRERENDER SAFETY
- Never touch window, document, localStorage or navigator at module or constructor level.
  Use the DOCUMENT token, afterNextRender() or isPlatformBrowser(). Prerender must not crash.
- No runtime fetch for page content. Content is imported through src/generated/content-index.ts
  (generated by tools/gen-content-index.mjs; never edit it by hand).

I18N (non-negotiable)
- Locale comes from the URL path only. Never from a cookie, header or navigator.language.
- Never generate a raw routerLink to an authored/internal path. Use `[appLink]` (CMS-authored links) or
  the navPath()/pagePath() helpers. No raw `routerLink="/about"` anywhere.
- Every user-visible UI string goes in i18n/{en,hi,mr}.json. No hardcoded English in templates.
- Every page emits reciprocal hreflang + x-default and a self-referencing canonical.
- Untranslated page rendered via fallback MUST be noindex.

SEO
- Every routed component calls SeoService.apply(...) and emits the right JSON-LD.
- The sitemap and prerender route list are generated from content/. Never hand-maintain them.

THEMING / STYLING
- Never hardcode a colour, font or radius. Use CSS custom properties from theme.tokens.scss,
  generated from site.config.json by tools/gen-theme.mjs.
- Mobile-first SCSS, WCAG 2.1 AA contrast, min 44px touch targets.
- Devanagari text uses the --font-indic stack.

CONTENT / BLOCKS
- A new block = standalone component + entry in block-registry.ts (or site-blocks/index.ts for one
  client) + CMS widget in public/admin/config.yml. All three, or it is not done.
- Blocks take typed input and render nothing when data is missing. Never throw on bad content.

NOTHING SITE-SPECIFIC IN CODE: branding/behaviour lives in site.config.json, words live in content/.

COMMANDS: npm start | npm run build (also generates sitemaps) | npm run check:seo | npm test | npm run new-site
